description: This file defines the OrderReturnServices class for handling order return-related business logic within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving return item costs, sending notification emails, managing return statuses, processing refunds and credits, and associated business processes related to order returns.

classes.name: OrderReturnServices
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to manage order return processing, notifications, and refunds within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getReturnItemInitialCost
methods.description: Retrieves the initial cost of a specific return item based on the return ID and return item sequence ID.

methods.name: getOrderAvailableReturnedTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount available for return by subtracting returned totals and adjustments from the order grand total.

methods.name: getReturnItemInitialCost
methods.description: Worker method that locates the return item and associated inventory cost.

methods.name: sendReturnNotificationScreen
methods.description: Helper method to compose and send notification emails regarding return status updates.

methods.name: sendReturnAcceptNotification
methods.description: Sends an acceptance notification email for a return.

methods.name: sendReturnCompleteNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification email indicating a return is complete.

methods.name: sendReturnCancelNotification
methods.description: Sends a cancellation notification email for a return.

methods.name: autoCancelReplacementOrders
methods.description: Automatically cancels replacement orders if the return is not received within a specified number of days and sends notifications.

methods.name: getReturnableQuantity
methods.description: Calculates how much of an order item is eligible for return, considering return policies and previous returns.

methods.name: getReturnableItems
methods.description: Builds a map of items that are eligible for return along with quantities and prices, filtering out non-returnable items.

methods.name: checkReturnComplete
methods.description: Checks the status of return items and updates the return header status accordingly.

methods.name: processCreditReturn
methods.description: Processes a credit (billing account) return, handling financial transactions and updating return item states.

methods.name: createBillingAccountFromReturn
methods.description: Creates a billing account (store credit) based on the return data, sets the account's expiration, and assigns roles.

methods.name: processRefundReturnForReplacement
methods.description: Handles the refund process for replacement orders, including refunds and notifications.

methods.name: processRefundReturn
methods.description: Processes a refund (cash/charge) return, managing payment transactions and updates.

methods.name: createPaymentApplicationsFromReturnItemResponse
methods.description: Creates payment applications based on the return item response, allocating amounts to invoices and handling related billing.

methods.name: refundBillingAccountPayment
methods.description: Handles refunding a billing account payment, creating necessary response and payment records, and associating refunds with billing accounts.

methods.name: createPaymentApplicationsFromReturnItemResponse
methods.description: Allocates refund amounts to associated invoices based on the return item response, creating payment applications accordingly.

methods.name: processReplacementReturn
methods.description: Creates replacement orders for returned items, adjusting order roles, inventory, and pricing for replacement process.
